name: Signal Cluster S17: Hold Until (Pulse to Zone)
description: Tests: hold_until with crossover/crossunder, enter priority over exit, zone execution with long_and_short_zone.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S17: Hold Until — Pulse to Zone Conversion
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === INDICATORS ===
fast_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# === PULSE SIGNALS ===
entry = crossover(fast_sma, slow_sma)
exit_sig = crossunder(fast_sma, slow_sma)

# === HOLD UNTIL — convert pulse to continuous zone ===
held_long = hold_until(entry, exit_sig)
held_short = hold_until(exit_sig, entry)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=10)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='SMA Crossover Signal',
    category='Signal',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fast SMA', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Slow SMA', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(fast_sma, slow_sma))
